notes: Recall/precision checklist for evaluating extraction quality, not an exact-match target -- a correct extraction phrases each requirement differently from source.quote below.
source.spans marks tender-document offsets a requirement originates from; source.quote is those spans' text, joined with ' ... ' when there is more than one span.

Exhaustive over bidder-facing, pre-award requirements in the RFQ: both text-verifiable ones (is_text_verifiable: true) and ones that describe a substantive compliance fact rather than an instruction to state something (is_text_verifiable: false).

No excluded_clauses list: text that is not a bidder requirement at all (Buy American/COTS/critical-component legal definitions, bare clause citations with no body text such as 852.219-73) is simply absent here.
fss_contract_listing is is_mandatory: false because it only applies to offerors that already hold an FSS contract.

country_of_origin_disclosure's source text says "(see column A)", but Attachment A's actual Country of Origin column is J, not A -- a real inconsistency in the source document, not a transcription error here.

or_equal_submission_requirements uses two spans: the short instruction to fill Attachment A columns F-K, and the fuller 52.211-6(b) checklist elsewhere in the document -- both govern the same submission requirement.

This case shares its RFQ template with 36C26226Q1384 (AquaSept) -- same items (a)-(j), same clauses -- but is a structurally different template from 36C24126Q0731 (Sorna Vertex): no explicit SDVOSB-certification sentence (852.219-73 appears only as a bare citation here), brand-name-OR-equal instead of brand-name-only, and Buy American Certificate/NMR Certification in place of the LOS/amendment-acknowledgment topics.

Offerors shall fill out columns “F-K” of Attachment A conforming to requirements stated by the salient characteristics which includes exact measurements and the instructions below. ... requirements.description: Quote must include the completed and signed Non-Manufacturing Rule (NMR) Certification (small business/non-manufacturer status, sourcing, no alteration of goods), including signature, name, title, date, and business name.

source.quote:
Non-Manufacturing Rule (NMR) Certification Clause
The Contractor hereby certifies that it complies with the Non-Manufacturing Rule (NMR) as outlined by the U.S. Small Business Administration (SBA) regulations and the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR). By entering into this contract, the Contractor certifies that:
Small Business Status:
The Contractor qualifies as a small business under the SBA size standards.
Non-Manufacturer Status:
The Contractor is primarily engaged in the retail or wholesale trade and normally supplies the type of product being provided in this contract.
The Contractor does not manufacture the products being supplied under this contract.
Source of Supply:
The Contractor will supply the product of a small business manufacturer or processor, unless a waiver of this requirement has been granted by the SBA.
The Echo Bed Cardiac Imaging Table falls under medical ultrasound equipment and accessories, which are covered in an NMR class waiver for Electromedical Apparatus Manufacturing under NAICS code 334510 posted in the Federal Register on 12/20/2007 under Register Notice number 72 FedReg 72433.
The products supplied will be manufactured or produced in the United States, unless an exception is permitted by applicable regulations.
Documentation and Compliance:
The Contractor agrees to maintain and provide documentation that verifies compliance with the NMR, upon request by the Contracting Officer or the SBA.
The Contractor will flow down this certification requirement to any subcontractors where applicable.
No Alteration of Goods:
The Contractor will not alter, modify, repackage, or rebrand the products supplied under this contract.
Timeliness and Accuracy:
The Contractor has made this certification at the time of submitting the offer in response to the solicitation.
All information provided in this certification is accurate and truthful to the best of the Contractor’s knowledge and belief.
Consequences of Non-Compliance:
The Contractor acknowledges that failure to comply with this certification may result in termination of the contract, debarment, suspension, or other legal action as deemed appropriate by the Contracting Officer or SBA.
